  Packages used by the bench: vbench, vbench2_beta_i2v, vbench2

LLaVA-NeXT, ArcFace, and ViTDetector are the copies under vbench2/third_party.
ViTDetector training data, assets, and its nested YOLO-World tree are not included.

YOLO-World and MMYOLO are under vbench2/third_party/YOLO-World.
Both are GPL-3.0. Their license files are kept next to that code.
The LVIS annotation dump is not included. Class text lists are in YOLO-World/data/texts.

SyncNetInstance.py and SyncNetModel.py are the lip-sync scorer.
base_68.npy and base_68_close.npy are the 68-point crop templates and are not in this tree.
